name: testraptor-x402-mcp
description: Pay-per-call TLS certificate checks, uptime monitoring, and page screenshots (x402, USDC/Solana) — no account or API key required.
long_description: MCP server exposing TestRaptor's paid APIs with per-call x402 payments (USDC on Solana, gas sponsored). Five tools: certs_check_now ($0.002), heartbeat_create_monitor ($0.003), pixeldrift_lancer_captures ($0.005), bundle_check ($0.008), and credit_topup (flexible amount). Two payment modes: payer wallet (X402_PAYER_KEY_B64) or prepaid credit (X402_CREDIT_TOKEN).
